readme:
# 多轮 SFT：回答标签与会话边界

## 1. 问题

一行中可能有多轮 assistant 回答，也可能拼接了不同会话。根据已经提供的 token 元数据，找出应该学习的目标位置。[TRL 的 assistant-only loss](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/sft_trainer#train-on-assistant-messages-only) 与[标签错位说明](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/sft_trainer#label-shifting-and-masking)是依据。本题不要求实现 tokenizer 或聊天模板。

实现：

```python
assistant_target_mask(role_ids: Tensor, conversation_ids: Tensor,
                      attention_mask: Tensor) -> Tensor
```

返回与输入同设备的 **bool Tensor `[B,T]`，标记目标 token 位置**。不是 attention 矩阵、错位后的掩码、token 编号或 loss。保留两个维度，不修改输入；整数与布尔元数据无需梯度。

## 2. 核心公式

用 `r`、`c`、`a` 表示角色、会话编号和有效性：

$$
m_{b,0}=\mathrm{False},\qquad
m_{b,j}=[r_{b,j}=2]\land a_{b,j}\land a_{b,j-1}\land[c_{b,j}=c_{b,j-1}],\quad j\ge1.
$$

前一个位置必须有效且属于同一会话，但**不要求前一个角色也是 assistant**：最后一个 user/上下文位置可以预测回答的首 token。输出不做错位；后续因果损失将 `logits[:, :-1]`、`tokens[:, 1:]` 和 `mask[:, 1:]` 对齐一次。

## 3. 从公式到代码

三个输入形状相同，均为 `[B,T]`。比较目标位置与紧邻前驱，组合角色、有效性与会话条件，并让第零列保持 false。B 或 T 可以为零；长度为一的维度不被压缩。

一行均有效的例子：

```text
角色：       [1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2]
会话编号：   [7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 9, 9]
目标掩码：   [F, T, T, F, T, T, F, T]
```

会话 7 的两轮回答都参与学习。位置 6 开始另一段 packed 会话，不能由位置 5 预测，即使两边都是 assistant token。

## 4. 本题约定

- CPU int64 的 `role_ids`、`conversation_ids`，bool 的 `attention_mask`，形状一致且 `B,T>=0`。输入保证符合约定，不考查输入校验；支持非连续视图。
- 有效位置的角色为 **0=system/角色头**、**1=user**、**2=assistant 内容**、**3=tool**。预处理将角色头和 BOS 标为 0。有效会话编号是非负 int64，不必连续，不同 batch 行可以复用编号。同一会话的所有轮次共享编号；相邻拼接的不同会话必须使用不同编号。
- `attention_mask=True` 表示真实保留的 token。padding 可以位于行首、行尾或中间，其角色/会话元数据可为任意 int64，不应影响输出。紧接 padding 的真实 token 没有有效的紧邻预测位置，因此不参与学习。
- **EOS 归属已提供**，不根据 token 编号推断。assistant 回答末尾的 EOS 标为角色 2，按同一规则参与；user/tool 的 EOS 保持相应角色。EOS 与 padding 即使使用同一 token 编号，也由有效性掩码区分。assistant EOS 不结束整段会话，也不会屏蔽后续轮次的回答。
- **截断由调用方先完成**。左截断后第零列没有保留的前驱，即使落在回答中间也不监督；后续可见回答 token 仍能参与。右截断保留末尾可见的合法目标，不补 EOS，也不因 EOS 被截掉而舍弃整段剩余回答。
- 角色编号、EOS 归属、会话编号布局与精确边界公式是 PaperLeet 明确的教学约定。[TRL 的 packing/截断文档](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/reducing_memory_usage#packing)解释了保留序列边界的背景；本题不复现所有 TRL packing 策略。

这是**损失目标掩码**，不能阻止 attention 跨会话读取上下文。真正的 packed 模型还需要独立处理 attention 与位置编号；本题不实现这些机制，也不实现聊天模板解析、tokenizer 或完整语言模型训练。

## 5. 交互实验

<viz id="toy_experiment" />

配套实验使用两行原创的 12-token 数据、四类词表和 11 个手工标注的 assistant 目标，包含多轮回答、assistant EOS、packed 边界、左截断片段及 padding 间隙。你的掩码控制各位置独立 logits 的 80 次 SGD 更新。

图表展示真实训练 NLL、独立目标上的 NLL，以及一行目标掩码。正确选择应学会 11 个目标，同时让被排除的预测位置 logits 完全不变。初始四类均匀 NLL 为 `log(4)`；最终目标 NLL 须小于 `.08`。这是确定性的合成优化实验，不代表留出集语言质量或预训练模型指标。Lab 参考预览使用参考实现，提交结果调用你的函数。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

把输出作为已有 `foundations/sft_loss_mask` 的 response mask，并传入原始有效性掩码；该损失内部只错位一次。进一步分别解释 tokenizer 如何标注角色、因果损失如何对齐标签、packed attention 如何隔离会话，避免把这三件事混为一谈。
starter:
import torch
from torch import Tensor


def assistant_target_mask(role_ids: Tensor, conversation_ids: Tensor, attention_mask: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    """Return a bool [B,T] mask at TARGET positions, without shifting the output.

    CPU int64 roles/conversation IDs and bool attention_mask have identical [B,T]
    shapes; either dimension may be zero. Valid roles: 0=system/header, 1=user,
    2=assistant content (including its EOS), 3=tool. Valid conversation IDs are
    nonnegative; padding metadata is arbitrary. For j>0, select an assistant
    target only when j and j-1 are both valid and share a conversation ID.
    Column zero is always false. No input mutation or gradient is required.
    """
    raise NotImplementedError
solution:
import torch
from torch import Tensor


def assistant_target_mask(role_ids: Tensor, conversation_ids: Tensor, attention_mask: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    result = torch.zeros_like(attention_mask)
    result[:, 1:] = (
        (role_ids[:, 1:] == 2)
        & attention_mask[:, 1:] & attention_mask[:, :-1]
        & (conversation_ids[:, 1:] == conversation_ids[:, :-1])
    )
    return result
notes:
# 实现笔记

输出标记的是**目标**角色，不是预测位置角色。user token 后可以是需要监督的 assistant token；assistant token 后也可以是不监督的 user token。用多轮案例同时检查这两个方向，不要先错位掩码，再在 loss 中重复错位。

只比较相邻位置的会话编号。把所有位置与第零列比较，会错误丢掉后续 packed 会话。编号数值、batch 排序和轮次数量都不影响规则。新会话首 token 没有同会话前驱，即使角色是 assistant 也排除。左截断后的第一个保留 token 同理；右截断既不抹掉此前的目标，也不补造 EOS。

有效性是独立输入：目标和紧邻前驱都必须是真实 token，padding 下的元数据不能参与决定。这也能区分相同编号的 EOS 与 PAD。调用方将 assistant EOS 标为角色 2，它仍是合法目标；算法不在第一轮回答或第一个 EOS 后停止。角色头和 BOS 已在上游标为 0。

时间复杂度 O(BT)，输出空间 O(BT)。B/T 为空时没有特殊 token；参考解仅写入新建的布尔结果，不修改输入。整数元数据不要求梯度，梯度测试验证的是掩码接入提供的损失后的效果，而非对角色编号求导。

## 来源范围

TRL SFT 文档提供 assistant-only 监督与 next-token 标签对齐的依据，packing 文档说明了不同策略和截断。数值角色、显式会话编号、EOS 归属与前驱规则是本题独立且受限的教学接口；不能据此宣称复现 TRL 预处理，也不能省略真实模型的 attention 隔离。

## 实验与验收

两行固定数据共 24 个 token 位置、11 个合法目标。每个预测位置独立拥有四个 float64 logits，全部从零开始；SGD 学习率为 4，执行恰好 80 次更新，不采样、不下载数据。标准种子为 42，但本实验没有随机调用。参考与提交代码使用相同训练循环。

独立手工标签决定评估 NLL 和哪些参数应保持不变。初始 NLL 为 ln(4)；正确实现应使最终目标 NLL 小于 .08、准确率等于 1，且每个被排除的 logit 变化严格为零。阈值在确定性参考结果之上留有余量，同时要求有实际优化。这不是留出集或共享语言模型实验，展示的是训练作用位置；所有曲线均来自真实更新。

四个 mutant 分别错误使用预测角色、遗漏会话边界、遗漏 padding、监督第零列。每个只改变一条规则，由直接断言捕获。在错误掩码上学到低 loss 不算通过：测试还检查独立目标损失、掩码差异和被排除参数的变化。

2026-10-17 校准：macOS arm64、Python 3.14.2、原生 Torch 2.14.1，最终目标 NLL 为 `0.02795611111943972`、准确率 `1.0`、排除 logits 变化 `0.0`。三轮原生参考/变异验证共 120 个测试用例通过，四个 mutant 全部被捕获。相同导出测试包在 Pyodide 0.29.4 / NumPy 2.2.5 中通过 8 个参考测试、四个断言捕获的 mutant 与 8 个学员测试，包含同样的 80 次训练更新。这是对应环境的正确性记录，不是通用延迟保证。

en.title: Multi-turn SFT: Assistant Targets and Conversation Boundaries
en.readme:
# Multi-turn SFT: Assistant Targets and Conversation Boundaries

## 1. Problem

Build the target mask for several assistant turns, including when conversations share a packed row. [TRL documents assistant-only loss](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/sft_trainer#train-on-assistant-messages-only) and [next-token label shifting](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/sft_trainer#label-shifting-and-masking). This exercise supplies structured token metadata instead of asking you to implement a tokenizer or chat template.

Implement:

```python
assistant_target_mask(role_ids: Tensor, conversation_ids: Tensor,
                      attention_mask: Tensor) -> Tensor
```

Return a **bool Tensor `[B,T]` at target positions**, on the input device. It is not an attention matrix, shifted mask, token-ID array or loss. Preserve both dimensions and leave all inputs unchanged. No gradients are needed for integer/boolean metadata.

## 2. Core rule

Let `r`, `c` and `a` be the role, conversation ID and validity arrays. Define

$$
m_{b,0}=\mathrm{False},\qquad
m_{b,j}=[r_{b,j}=2]\land a_{b,j}\land a_{b,j-1}\land[c_{b,j}=c_{b,j-1}],\quad j\ge1.
$$

The predecessor must exist in the same conversation, but **its role need not be assistant**: the last user/context position can predict the first assistant token. Return the mask without shifting it. A supplied causal loss later pairs `logits[:, :-1]`, `tokens[:, 1:]` and `mask[:, 1:]` exactly once.

## 3. From metadata to code

All inputs have the same `[B,T]` shape. Compare target positions with their immediate predecessors, combine the role/validity/boundary conditions, and leave the first column false. B or T may be zero; singleton dimensions remain present.

For one row with all positions valid:

```text
role:          [1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2]
conversation:  [7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 9, 9]
target mask:   [F, T, T, F, T, T, F, T]
```

Both assistant turns in conversation 7 contribute. Position 6 begins a different packed conversation and cannot be predicted by position 5, even though both are assistant tokens.

## 4. Exercise conventions

- CPU int64 `role_ids` and `conversation_ids`; bool `attention_mask`. Shapes match, with `B,T>=0`. Inputs are valid; validation is not part of the required function. Strided inputs work.
- At valid positions roles are **0=system/header**, **1=user**, **2=assistant content**, **3=tool**. Chat headers and BOS are marked 0 by preprocessing. Valid conversation IDs are nonnegative int64, need not be consecutive, and may be reused in another batch row. All turns of a conversation share its ID; adjacent packed conversations use different IDs.
- `attention_mask=True` means a real, retained token. Padding can appear at either end or inside a row. Metadata under padding may contain arbitrary int64 values and must not affect the result. A real token immediately after padding has no valid immediate predictor and is excluded.
- **EOS ownership is supplied**, not inferred from token IDs. An EOS ending an assistant response has role 2 and is eligible under the same rule. User/tool EOS retains that turn's role. The same token ID can also serve as padding; only the validity mask distinguishes it here. An assistant EOS does not end the entire conversation or suppress later assistant turns.
- **Truncation happens before this function.** At a left cut, column zero has no retained predictor, even if it is inside an assistant response. Later visible assistant targets can still contribute. At a right cut, retain eligible targets through the last visible token; do not invent an EOS or discard a partial answer merely because its EOS was cut away.
- Roles, EOS ownership, ID layout and the exact boundary formula are explicit PaperLeet teaching conventions. [TRL's packing/truncation guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/reducing_memory_usage#packing) motivates tracking sequence boundaries; this function does not reproduce every TRL packing strategy.

This is a **loss-target mask**, not protection against attention crossing conversations. A packed model needs separate attention/position handling. The exercise does not implement that handling, chat-template parsing, tokenization or language-model training.

## 5. Experiment

<viz id="toy_experiment" />

The supplied experiment has two original 12-token rows, four vocabulary classes and eleven hand-labelled assistant targets. It includes several turns, assistant EOS, a packed boundary, a left-truncated assistant segment and a padding gap. Your returned mask controls 80 SGD updates of independently parameterized position logits.

Charts show actual training NLL, NLL on the independently labelled targets, and one row's target mask. Correct selection learns the eleven targets while excluded predictor logits stay exactly unchanged. The initial four-way uniform NLL is `log(4)`; the accepted final target NLL is below `.08`. These are deterministic synthetic optimization results, not held-out language quality or a pretrained-model benchmark. Reference Lab previews call the solution; submitted artifacts call your function.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further work

Feed this mask into the existing `foundations/sft_loss_mask` loss as its response mask, together with the original validity mask. That function shifts targets once. Then explain separately what a tokenizer must label, what a causal loss must shift, and what a packed attention implementation must isolate. Those are distinct responsibilities.
en.notes:
# Implementation notes

The output describes the role of the **target**, not the predictor. A user token can precede a supervised assistant token; an assistant token can precede an unsupervised user token. Check both directions in a multi-turn example. Do not shift the returned mask and then shift it again in the loss.

Only adjacent conversation-ID equality matters. Do not compare every token with column zero: that would lose later packed conversations. ID magnitude, batch order and the number of turns are irrelevant. At a packed boundary, the new conversation's first token lacks a predictor from that conversation, even if its role is assistant. At left truncation, the first retained token is similarly excluded. Right truncation does not erase earlier targets or create a missing EOS.

Validity is a separate input. A target and its immediate predecessor must both be real tokens; metadata under padding is deliberately untrusted. This matters when EOS and PAD use the same token ID. Supplied assistant EOS has role 2, so it remains eligible; the mask does not stop at the first assistant response or first EOS. Headers/BOS are assigned role 0 upstream.

The boolean computation is O(BT), with O(BT) output storage. Empty B/T dimensions need no special token. The reference writes only a newly allocated boolean result; it never modifies caller tensors. Integer masks have no derivative contract. The gradient test verifies the effect of using the mask in a supplied loss, not a gradient through role IDs.

## Source scope

The TRL SFT documentation establishes assistant-only supervision and next-token label alignment. Its packing guide describes multiple strategies and truncation. Our numeric roles, explicit conversation IDs, EOS ownership and predecessor rule form an original, bounded teaching interface. We do not claim that this function reproduces TRL preprocessing or makes attention isolation unnecessary.

## Experiment and acceptance

Two fixed rows contain 24 token positions and eleven valid targets. Each predictor owns four trainable float64 logits, initially zero. SGD uses learning rate 4 for exactly 80 updates; no sampling or data download occurs. The standard seed is 42 but this probe makes no random draws. Reference and learner calls execute the same loop.

An independent hand-labelled mask defines evaluation NLL and excluded parameters. Starting NLL is ln(4); correct runs reach target NLL below .08 and accuracy 1, with exactly zero change to every excluded logit. The final tolerance leaves room above the deterministic reference result while requiring useful optimization. There is no held-out dataset or shared language model here: the experiment demonstrates which parameters receive training, not generalization. All plotted losses are measured from the optimizer trajectory.

The four mutants use predictor roles, omit conversation boundaries, omit padding, or supervise column zero. Each changes one rule and is caught by direct assertions. In particular, learning a low loss on a wrong mask is insufficient: independent target loss, mask disagreements and excluded-parameter changes are checked too.

Calibration on 2026-10-17: Python 3.14.2 / native Torch 2.14.1, macOS arm64, produced final target NLL `0.02795611111943972`, accuracy `1.0`, and excluded-logit change `0.0`. Three native reference/mutation runs passed (120 test cases, all four mutants caught). The unchanged exported suite also passed in Pyodide 0.29.4 / NumPy 2.2.5: 8 reference tests, four assertion-caught mutants and 8 learner tests, including the same 80-step experiment. This records correctness on these runners, not a universal latency guarantee.
